faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.

q1.question: How does the platform work?
q1.answer: You create your organization, invite your team and configure your product. Auth, billing and multi-tenancy are ready: start from day one.

q2.question: Do I need technical skills?
q2.answer: Customizing the branding takes a few environment variables. Extending the product requires knowing Nuxt and TypeScript.

q3.question: Is it really multi-tenant?
q3.answer: Yes. Every account is an organization and every resource is isolated per tenant. The model is B2B-first with B2C as a special case.

q4.question: Is my data safe?
q4.answer: Absolutely. We use standard encryption, are GDPR compliant and support data export and deletion on request.

q5.question: Can I try before paying?
q5.answer: Join the waiting list to get priority access and a lifetime discount. Early users also get one month of Premium free.

q6.question: When will it be available?
q6.answer: We are working on the launch. Join the waiting list to be among the first to try the platform and get updates.

chiSiamo.seoDescription: Ceremly was born in 2026 from three people and a wedding organized with spreadsheets. Digital invitations and RSVPs built for events.
chiSiamo.heroSub: Ceremly was born in 2026 from three people and a wedding organized with spreadsheets, voice notes and calls to the mother-in-law.
chiSiamo.intro1: The idea came the evening Andrea, three days before his wedding, called the caterer with three different numbers on three different sheets. The invitations had been beautiful. The guest list, a nightmare. We wondered why in 2026 you could book a flight in two minutes, but not know how many uncles were coming to lunch.
chiSiamo.intro2: So we built Ceremly: digital invitations that hold their own next to paper ones, and a reply form anyone can use — no app, no account, no explaining over the phone. Today we're in beta, small by choice, growing one event at a time.

principi.d: No gift registries, no albums, no showcase sites. Ceremly answers one question — who's coming? — and that's it. What we don't do is a choice, not a gap.

principi.t: The data belongs to the hosts
principi.d: Guest lists are never sold, profiled, or fed into ads. EU servers, full export anytime, real deletion when you ask for it.
Italian events, Italian etiquette, Italian e-invoicing. We build for how people celebrate here: big families, late confirmations and long lunches.

team.d: Counted his 187 wedding guests by hand. Never again.
Believes an ugly invitation ruins the party before it starts.
Wants the RSVP form to open even on grandma's phone.

chiSiamo.ctaSub: The best way to get to know us is to use Ceremly for your next event.
